# Sober Sidekick

> > Sober Sidekick is a sobriety tracking app providing peer support and anonymous community for addiction recovery, with partnerships including Optum EWS.

Sober Sidekick offers a mobile application combining sobriety tracking tools with peer-to-peer support features similar to Alcoholics Anonymous meetings. The platform emphasizes anonymous community connection and mental health support for individuals in recovery.

## Key Topics

- addiction recovery
- sobriety tracking
- peer support community
- anonymous support groups
- mental health and wellbeing
- Alcoholics Anonymous (AA) meetings
- recovery tracker tools
- sober community
- Optum EWS partnership
- mobile sobriety app
- substance abuse recovery
- behavioral health support

## Get Started

- [Download Now | Sober Sidekick](https://www.sobersidekick.com/app-landing-page): App download page for Sober Sidekick sobriety tracker and AA support

## Partnerships & Programs

- [Optum EWS | Sober Sidekick](https://www.sobersidekick.com/optum-ews): Partnership program combining Sober Sidekick peer support with Optum EWS care
